Antalya Paragliding Day Trip to Ölüdeniz

Fly from the world's best paragliding site without leaving your Antalya holiday. Day trip with hotel pickup from Antalya, Kemer, Belek, or Side.

Can You Do Paragliding from Antalya?

While there are small paragliding operations near Antalya (Alanya, Kaş), none compare to Ölüdeniz — the world's #1 tandem paragliding destination. Babadağ Mountain (1,960m) offers flights 3-4 times longer than typical Antalya-area sites, with a breathtaking Blue Lagoon landing.

The drive from Antalya to Ölüdeniz is approximately 3 hours along the stunning D400 coastal highway. Our day trip package handles everything so you can simply enjoy.

Antalya → Ölüdeniz Day Trip Itinerary

  1. 05:30 — Hotel Pickup: Private air-conditioned transfer from your Antalya hotel (also Kemer, Belek, Side — pickup time varies).
  2. 05:30–08:30 — Scenic Drive: The route hugs the Mediterranean coast through Kaş and Kalkan. One of Turkey's most beautiful drives.
  3. 09:00 — Babadağ Takeoff: Cable car to summit, safety briefing, and your tandem flight begins.
  4. 09:45 — Beach Landing: Touch down on Belcekiz Beach overlooking the Blue Lagoon.
  5. 10:00–14:00 — Free Time: Swim, explore Ölüdeniz village, lunch at a waterfront restaurant.
  6. 14:00–17:00 — Return to Antalya: Relaxed drive back to your hotel.
